nodes.label: Environment-specific Settings
nodes.rationale: Settings split by environment (local.py, production.py, test.py) importing from common.py; DRF, JWT, Celery config in config/conf/

nodes.label: JWT Authentication System
nodes.rationale: JWT via djangorestframework-simplejwt; custom permission classes and throttles in core/permissions/ and core/throttle/

nodes.label: Redis Caching System
nodes.rationale: Redis via django-redis + django-cacheops; toggled by CACHE_ENABLED environment variable

nodes.label: Background Task Processing
nodes.rationale: Celery 5 with Redis broker/backend; beat scheduler for periodic tasks

nodes.label: Prometheus Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Prometheus metrics at /metrics/; optional Silk profiling with SILK_ENABLED=True

nodes.label: Testing Framework (pytest-django)
nodes.rationale: Tests use pytest-django with model_bakery for fixtures; test DB is PostgreSQL, settings module config.settings.test
